organization: UK Department for Transport / Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency
title: df_VEH0160_UK — Vehicles registered for the first time by body type, make, generic model, model and fuel
license_evidence: Official metadata page footer states all content is available under OGL v3.0 unless otherwise stated; no contrary dataset restriction identified.
geography: UK national; ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 GB; no state/city model detail
coverage: BodyType Cars only; all generic models and fuels; separate full annual aggregates and published quarters
limitations: First UK registrations include imported vehicles, including previously used imports. Not equivalent to SMMT new-car sales. Administrative make/model errors and missing generic-model categories are preserved. Quarterly data must never be interpolated to months. Prices and SUV/sedan/hatch segments absent.

organization: Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders
title: UK new car market breaches two million as almost one in four buyers go electric
reference_years: 2025 complete year; December 2025 tables also published
license: Copyright SMMT; terms permit personal non-commercial use of site materials; other uses require express permission. Not open data.
license_evidence: Official Terms of use, Intellectual property rights section, permits personal non-commercial use and requires express permission for other uses. Detailed statistics are offered through DataShop.
geography: UK national (GB ISO country code); no state detail in public release
coverage: Top 10 models 2025, all powertrains, denominator 2,020,520 new passenger cars from same publication
limitations: Only top 10 models; model-specific segment and fuel absent from this total-market ranking. Do not infer all Puma registrations as petrol or all SUVs from a model name. Do not combine with DfT first registrations.

organization: Secretaria Nacional de Trânsito / Ministério dos Transportes
title: Registro Nacional de Veículos Automotores — RENAVAM; Frota de veículos 2025
reference_years: 2025 monthly inventory snapshots; portal also lists other years
license: Other (Public Domain), as stated by official CKAN catalog
license_evidence: Official dataset metadata explicitly lists Outra (Domínio Público).
geography: UF and municipality, including make/model inventory
limitations: These are inventory counts of the registered fleet, not new-car sales. Differences between inventory snapshots mix inflows, ownership/location changes and exits. They cannot establish best-selling models per UF.

title: Central de Dados — metodologia e emplacamentos
reference_years: Historical series; page includes methodological change from 2026
license: No open redistribution license identified on consulted page; provider terms apply
coverage: Published filters by vehicle type, origin, period, company, brand and fuel; not a public full model×UF dataset verified here
limitations: Before/through 2001 emplacamento series refers to wholesale sales; current emplacamento source identified as Renavam/Senatran. Avoid mixing production and sales. No model×state figures extracted.

limitations: Country/type market totals do not identify best-selling individual models by state. Do not redistribute raw OICA files under the project's software license.

title: Electric Vehicle Population Data
license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0
